items.title: Station-native authenticated session forwarding
items.problem: Remote users establish the Station tunnel outside the session browser.
items.desiredOutcome: An authenticated Station transport forwards the loopback control plane without public bind or new credentials.
items.hypothesis: If we deliver "An authenticated Station transport forwards the loopback control plane without public bind or new credentials.", positive metrics rise on hobo-code attach, session browser.
items.smallestExperiment: Integrate only after Station transport and user-scoped identity contracts expose a forwarding port.
